resources.name: Open-source DFT code with PAW PW91 support

access.notes: Any DFT code capable of PAW pseudopotentials and PW91 GGA can be used (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT).

resources.name: PAW pseudopotentials for Sr and Si

access.notes: Standard SSSP or PSlibrary PAW potentials with Sr valence 10 electrons and Si valence 4 electrons.

resources.name: Crystal structure databases (Bilbao Crystallographic Server, Materials Project, ICSD)

access.notes: Prototype structures for all 26 lattices can be obtained from public databases or constructed from Pearson symbols.

resources.name: Python packages for structure manipulation and analysis

access.notes: Used for generating structures, managing DFT runs, and fitting equations of state.
